subject: Post-demo: PoC success criteria, model shortlist, and ownership
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Velasquez <anna@cortex.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap — PoC success criteria, model shortlist, next steps

Hi Anna — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so Cortex can get to a short pilot quickly.

Summary of asks from Cortex:
- Primary goals: accurate triage suggestions in English and Spanish, under 200ms p50 server-side latency for single-turn inference, and <5% critical hallucination rate over evaluation prompts.
- Volume expectation: ~120k inference requests/month during pilot (10k daily peak), average prompt length ~120 tokens.
- Data handling: PII redaction on ingest, logs retained for 30 days.

Proposed PoC plan (high-level):
1) Duration: 3 weeks of evaluation + 1 week for wrap-up and acceptance.
2) Evaluation sets: we will run your 1,200 labeled prompts (you shared the sample) plus a 300-case Spanish subset for locale coverage.
3) Success criteria (to be finalized in the attached spreadsheet):
   - Latency: p50 <= 200ms, p95 <= 450ms for single-request calls.
   - Quality: Top-1 accuracy/intent match >= 88% on English set, >= 82% on Spanish set.
   - Hallucination: critical hallucination rate <= 5% across both sets.
   - Throughput: sustained 200 RPS for 30s bursts.
4) Model shortlist for the pilot (initial):
   - Primary candidate: Llama-2-13B (quantized runtime) — best balance of quality & latency for English.
   - Multilingual candidate: Mistral-7B-Multilingual (or equivalent) for Spanish fallback tests.
   - Lightweight fallback: Llama-2-7B-Q4 for cost-sensitive route if high load or for batch processing.

Ownership / next steps I propose:
- Marcus (me): PoC coordination, infra defaults, primary contact for operations.
- Neha: evaluation rubric and analysis, ties to your product metrics.
- Priyom: model runtime configuration and fallback policy + cost projection.

Action items (immediate):
- Marcus: share the PoC success criteria spreadsheet and sample prompts (attached).
- Anna: confirm the Spanish subset and provide any redaction rules you want applied before evaluation.
- Cortex: sign the PoC MOU (I’ll circulate a short template).

Attachments: Cortex_PoC_Success_Criteria.xlsx, cortex_sample_prompts.jsonl, network_requirements.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with times for a short kickoff next week.

Best,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Anna Velasquez <anna@cortex.health>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — PoC success criteria, model shortlist, next steps

Thanks Marcus — this is exactly the level of detail we wanted. A few clarifications from our end: 

1) Spanish coverage: the Spanish subset is primarily Latin American Spanish (MX/AR/CO). We have 320 prompts for this set; I’ll upload the final file by EOD Tuesday.
2) Data handling: we need PII redaction on our side and logs masked before they are stored in your analytics pipeline. 30-day retention is fine.
3) Latency: 200ms p50 is ambitious but acceptable for the pilot. If we see consistent regressions we’ll accept an interim SLA with a 1.25x latency buffer during tuning.

Can you also confirm the following:
- Will Redwood run the pilot on hosted infra (your hosted API) or do you recommend Dedicated? We prefer hosted to get started, but we need region controls (us-west).
- Is the multilingual candidate run as a single multilingual model or as a language-specific fallback?

We’re ready to proceed pending the MOU and your confirmation on infra.

—Anna
Anna Velasquez
Director, Product Integrations | Cortex Health
anna@cortex.health
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — PoC success criteria, model shortlist, next steps

Looping in a quick internal checklist so we don’t lose momentum. I’ll own the rubric and final acceptance calc.

Internal checklist / owners: 
- Rubric creation: Neha — I’ll draft per the spreadsheet, mapping your business labels -> evaluation metrics. Deliverable: evaluation_rubric_v1.xlsx by 18 Sep.
- Prompt normalization: Priyom — run the Spanish subset through our normalization pipeline (tokenization, punctuation heuristics). Deliverable: prompts_normalized.jsonl by 17 Sep.
- Env & infra: Marcus — confirm hosted-us-west allocation and request any temporary elevated throughput (burst capacity) for peak days.
- Telemetry & masking: Ops (cc’d via ticket) — ensure PII masking hook is applied; confirm logs retention and access controls.

Model plan (technical):
- Start on hosted Redwood API in us-west with model variants pinned per route. Priyom will configure routing: primary -> Llama-2-13B-quant (low-latency), fallback -> Mistral-7B-Multi for Spanish heavy prompts, cost-fallback route -> Llama-2-7B-Q4 for batch scoring.
- For evaluation, we’ll run A/B slices: 40% 13B, 40% Mistral (for Spanish/edge cases), 20% 7B to validate cost tradeoffs.

I’ll prep the rubric and a short script for automated scoring. Marcus — please send the MOU template and we’ll attach the rubric and schedule.

-Neha
From: Anna Velasquez <anna@cortex.health>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — PoC success criteria, model shortlist, next steps

Perfect — thank you both. A couple small asks before we sign the MOU: 

1) Could you include a short acceptance test case example in the MOU (one English, one Spanish) so we have shared expectations?
2) Pricing: we want a cap on pilot spend (not to exceed $4k) and a per-token estimate per model variant.

We will upload the finalized Spanish prompt file by 17:30 PT and share a lightweight NDA addendum if needed (I’ll attach if required).

Anna
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Velasquez <anna@cortex.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — PoC success criteria, model shortlist, next steps

Great — appreciate the quick turnaround, Anna. Next items from Redwood side: 

1) MOU & acceptance examples: I’ve uploaded a short MOU template to the SharePoint link (see related_links) and added two acceptance test rows in the attached spreadsheet.
2) Pricing cap & estimate: Priyom — can you prepare a quick pilot budget with per-token estimates for the three model routes (13B quant, Mistral-7B-Multi, 7B-Q4) and confirm if burst capacity will require a temporary quota increase? Target for that by EOD Friday.
3) Kickoff call: propose Tue, 23 Sep 2025 10:00 AM PT — 30 min to align infra, handshake tests, and confirm dataset upload. Please confirm availability.

Attachments: Cortex_PoC_Success_Criteria.xlsx, cortex_sample_prompts.jsonl, network_requirements.pdf

Talk soon — Marcus
